## Pull request overview

This PR migrates the official documentation site from VitePress to Fumadocs, establishing a new Next.js 15-based documentation site at `/apps/site` with MDX content support.

**Changes:**
- Sets up a new Next.js 15 app with Fumadocs UI framework, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript
- Creates MDX-based documentation content (Introduction, Quick Start, Installation)
- Implements a workaround for fumadocs-mdx source API compatibility issues

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 22 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| package.json | Adds workspace scripts for site development, build, and start commands |
| apps/site/package.json | Defines dependencies for Next.js 15, Fumadocs packages, and React 18 |
| apps/site/tsconfig.json | Configures TypeScript with Next.js-specific settings |
| apps/site/tailwind.config.ts | Sets up Tailwind with Fumadocs UI component scanning |
| apps/site/next.config.mjs | Configures Next.js with MDX support via fumadocs-mdx |
| apps/site/source.config.ts | Defines MDX compilation configuration for docs directory |
| apps/site/lib/source.ts | Implements workaround for fumadocs source API compatibility |
| apps/site/app/*.tsx | Creates root layout, homepage, and docs layout components |
| apps/site/app/docs/[[...slug]]/page.tsx | Implements dynamic docs page renderer with metadata generation |
| apps/site/content/docs/*.mdx | Adds documentation content pages |
| apps/site/.gitignore | Ignores Next.js, Fumadocs, and build artifacts |
</details>

</details>
The property name `default` is ambiguous in this context. Consider using a more descriptive name like `component` or `content` to clarify what this represents in the data structure.
Type assertion to `any` removes type safety. Define a proper interface for the page data structure to maintain type safety throughout the component.

Multiple type assertions to `any` in the same expression reduces type safety. Define an interface for the expected page data structure with properties like `toc`, `full`, `title`, `description`, and `body`.

The component name `ObjectUIRenderer` does not align with the architectural guideline that references `<SchemaRenderer>` as the primary runtime component. Consider using `SchemaRenderer` for consistency with the documented architecture.
